title: Woodland Scene 9 — Find the Woodland Animal
purpose: Finding an animal from several descriptive clues and comparing features.

sentenceModels: Point to the animal with long ears.
Which animal has the bushy tail?
The deer is bigger than the rabbit.

adultSupport.focus: Encourage Basti to listen for several features and find the correct animal.
starterPrompts: Can you find the spiky animal?
Which one has a big bushy tail?
Who is sitting on the stump?
expansionPrompts: First point to the rabbit, then point to the fox.
Tell me two things about the owl.

visualAudit: One deer with antlers in the centre-left.
One rabbit with long ears on the lower-left.
One squirrel on a stump and one owl on a branch on the right.
One fox on the lower-right with a bushy tail.
One hedgehog near the bottom centre.
